items.source: Default Method styling function: converts the supplied Method to a simple string representation of the method's signature in the form of <method name>(<parameter types>), where <parameter types> is a comma-separated list of the simple names of the parameter types.

Special implementation of the Errors and BindingResult interfaces,
supporting registration and evaluation of binding errors on value objects.
items.translation: Errors 和 BindingResult 接口的特殊实现，支持在值对象上注册和评估绑定错误。

items.source:
Invoked after any error (either from the upstream write Publisher, or
from I/O operations to the underlying server) and cancellation
to discard in-flight data that was in
the process of being written when the error took place.
items.translation: 在发生任何错误（无论是来自上游写入 Publisher 还是来自到底层服务器的 I/O 操作）以及取消时调用，以丢弃在错误发生时正在写入过程中的飞行数据。

items.source: Disconnect the session by sending a DISCONNECT frame.
items.translation: 通过发送 DISCONNECT 帧断开会话。

items.source:
Actually close the underlying WebSocket session or in the case of HTTP
transports complete the underlying request.
items.translation: 实际上关闭底层的 WebSocket 会话，或在 HTTP 传输的情况下完成底层请求。

items.source:
Utility methods to assist with identifying and logging exceptions that
indicate the server response connection is lost, for example because the
client has gone away.
items.translation: 用于辅助识别和记录表示服务器响应连接已丢失的异常的工具方法，例如因为客户端已断开连接。

items.source:
Dispatch the request to the container in order to resume processing after
concurrent execution in an application thread.
items.translation: 将请求分派到容器中，以便在应用程序线程中的并发执行后恢复处理。

items.source: Central dispatcher for HTTP request handlers/controllers.
items.translation: HTTP 请求处理器/控制器的中央调度器。

items.source:
Central dispatcher for HTTP request handlers/controllers, for example, for web UI controllers
or HTTP-based remote service exporters.
items.translation: HTTP 请求处理器/控制器的中央调度器，例如用于 Web UI 控制器或基于 HTTP 的远程服务导出器。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by beans that want to release resources on destruction.
items.translation: 希望销毁时释放资源的 Bean 需要实现的接口。

items.source: Create a JMS Connection via this template's ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 通过此模板的 ConnectionFactory 创建 JMS 连接。

items.source: Execute the given method on the provided URI.
items.translation: 在提供的 URI 上执行给定方法。

items.source:
Execute the specified listener,
committing or rolling back the transaction afterwards (if necessary).
items.translation: 执行指定的监听器，并在必要时提交或回滚事务。

items.source: Return an instance, which may be shared or independent, of the specified bean.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的实例，该实例可能是共享的或独立的。

items.source: Initiate the handshake.
items.translation: 发起握手。

items.source: Route the invocation to the configured managed resource.
items.translation: 将调用路由到配置的托管资源。

items.source: Actually load bean definitions from the specified XML file.
items.translation: 实际上从指定的 XML 文件加载 bean 定义。

items.source: Set the cookie "Domain" attribute.
items.translation: 设置 Cookie 的 "Domain" 属性。

items.source:
Convenience methods for working with the DOM API,
in particular for working with DOM Nodes and DOM Elements.
items.translation: 用于操作 DOM API 的便捷方法，特别是用于操作 DOM Node 和 DOM Element。

items.source: Actually parse the expression string and return an Expression object.
items.translation: 解析表达式字符串并返回一个 Expression 对象。

items.source: Actually receive a message from the given destination.
items.translation: 实际上从给定的目的地接收消息。

items.source: Actually send the given message to the given destination.
items.translation: 实际上将给定的消息发送到给定的目的地。

items.source:
Actually send the given request message to the given destination and
receive a reply message for it.
items.translation: 实际上向给定的目的地发送请求消息，并接收其回复消息。

items.source: Called by doStartTag to perform the actual work.
items.translation: 由 doStartTag 调用以执行实际工作。

items.source: Template method for actually translating the given exception.
items.translation: 用于实际翻译给定异常的模板方法。

items.source: Constructor for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 风格配置的构造函数。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an attempt to insert or update data
results in violation of a primary key or unique constraint.
items.translation: 尝试插入或更新数据时，如果违反了主键或唯一约束，将抛出异常。

items.source: Abstract base class for dynamically generated files.
items.translation: 动态生成文件的抽象基类。

items.source:
Subinterface of AOP Alliance Advice that allows additional interfaces
to be implemented by an Advice, and available via a proxy using that
interceptor.
items.translation: AOP 联盟 Advice 的子接口，允许 Advice 实现额外的接口，并通过该拦截器通过代理访问这些接口。

items.source:
Convenient abstract superclass for dynamic method matchers,
which do care about arguments at runtime.
items.translation: 用于动态方法匹配器的便捷抽象父类，这些匹配器在运行时确实关心参数。

items.source:
Convenient superclass when we want to force subclasses to
implement MethodMatcher interface, but subclasses
will want to be pointcuts.
items.translation: 当我们需要强制子类实现 MethodMatcher 接口，但子类将作为切点使用时，这是一个方便的父类。
